scope: All rows in docs/reference/due-diligence-source-map.md; public GET-only source feasibility; no production activation
authorization: User requested each mapped source experiment and retained golden samples on 2026-10-09

network.robots: 200 rules obeyed; 404/410 treated as absent; denial, network error or invalid document => policy unknown/blocked

failure_contracts: Every input row has exactly one final report row; duplicate URLs retain independent map IDs
200 challenge, login, error page or JS shell is not business-data extraction success
Robots unknown/denied is a policy result, not evidence the content URL itself is down
Network failures are current-environment observations, never proof of permanent source unavailability
Each sent request has a ledger entry; budgets include robots and redirect hops
Session identifiers and sensitive headers do not enter generated artifacts
Golden bytes are unchanged archived application bodies with sha256 and explicit extraction expectations
Fetch/extraction golden samples do not assert full-site completeness or production review approval
Offline golden verification makes zero network requests and reports deterministic assertion outcomes
Failures and interrupted campaigns are retained; no stealth retries, proxy rotation or CAPTCHA bypass

golden_tiers.entry: Public non-challenge HTML with stable title and locator evidence; verifies entry parsing only
golden_tiers.content: Public list/detail/PDF with independently checked expected facts; verifies specified extraction fields only
